waypoints.name: Fremont Peak summit
waypoints.note: SummitPost trailhead page lists Fremont Peak via Indian Basin 15 mi from Elkhart Park; a SummitPost route page gives about 30 mi round trip, halved. A 14ers.com report (~10 mi to Seneca Lake + 16 mi RT onward) implies ~18, so figures vary 15-18.

waypoints.name: Gannett Peak summit
waypoints.note: SummitPost (snippet): Tourist Creek / Wells Creek routes are about 18 mi from Green River Lakes TH to the summit. 'West Face' not confirmed on that page; another source puts upper Green to Three Forks Park at 8 mi. Low confidence.
